skipped.why: Fists: no weapon model (v_berserk_merc is a 3-vertex stub; the hands are c_merc_arms). Keeps inheriting stock 'fists'.
Old Merc pistol: world model is stock w_pistol and v_pistol_4rdm has the same geometry; inherits stock 'pistol'.
Old Merc shotgun: stock w_shotgun world model, v_shotgun_4rdm = stock engineer shotgun mesh; inherits 'shotgun'.
Old Merc flare gun: stock w_flaregun world model; inherits 'flaregun'.
Mine Layer 1-6: stock TF2C minelayer model, already 'proxymine'.
AF Medic Shotgun: stock shotgun meshes (v_shotgun_medic = engineer shotgun mesh, w_shotgun stock).
Little Boy / Fat Man: tf_wearable, no weapon model, never the killing weapon.
tf2cc_merc_body: body wearable, not a weapon.

customslop: CustomSlop daily weapons get no icons of their own (user, 2026-11-16): each keeps its donor item's item_iconname (stock name or tf2cc_<item>_vN). After any tf2cc item_iconname change, refresh CustomSlop's donor roster cache (cache/donor_audit.json / model roster) so new CustomSlop weapons copy the current names; the SVGs reach clients through tf2cc's downloads list.
